4 آنَقَنِى , (S, Msb, K,) inf. n. إِيْنَاقٌ and نِيقٌ, (K,) [but the latter is properly a quasi-inf. n.,] It excited my admiration and approval; pleased me; or rejoiced me. (S, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- مَا آنَقَهُ فِى كَذَا How vehemently does he seek, or pursue, or desire, such a thing! or how vehement is he in seeking, pursuit, or desire, with respect to such a thing! (JK, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
